assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: transparent horizontal logo PNG for ScratchXR, an educational web experience on computational thinking and mixed reality for ages 10–16.
Primary request: Create a polished friendly wordmark, exact text "ScratchXR", letter-by-letter S c r a t c h X R, paired with a compact abstract symbol on the left. The symbol is two interlocking coding-block shapes becoming a dimensional square portal, clearly readable at small size.
Style: crisp geometric graphic design, solid colored areas, no outlines, restrained dimensional facets in the symbol, carefully drawn rounded geometric sans-serif lettering.
Composition: one centered horizontal logo, symbol left and wordmark right, generous transparent padding, no repeated variants, wide image.
Color palette: deep violet ink #28233F for Scratch, saturated violet #7662E8 for XR, tangerine #FF8B59 and pale mint #A7DCCD for parts of the symbol.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, sharp legible edges, only the exact text "ScratchXR", no tagline, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no copyrighted mascot, no cats, no existing game characters, no frames.
assets.review: Exact wordmark checked; actual alpha channel verified.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: wide text-free educational infographic for ScratchXR computational thinking.
Primary request: a single beautiful horizontal isometric illustration with four clearly separated connected stations read from left to right: (1) DECOMPOSITION visually represented by one geometric building separating into four simple colored components, (2) PATTERN RECOGNITION shown as a tidy repeating sequence of alternating cubes and arches with the repeated group visually highlighted by a pale platform, (3) ABSTRACTION shown as a richly detailed tiny tree simplified into a minimal geometric tree silhouette beside it, (4) ALGORITHM shown as a visible sequence of three interlocking coding puzzle blocks leading along a stepped path to a small flag. Convey these four concepts through objects only; absolutely no words, letters, digits or labels.
Style/medium: modern isometric flat illustration made from solid shapes, no outlines or strokes, consistent 30 degree isometric view, sophisticated playful classroom editorial illustration for ages 10–16.
Composition: wide 16:9, four stations have equivalent weight in a clear row connected by a simple pale curved route, objects large and uncluttered with ample margins and blank space above each station so the website can overlay labels separately.
Palette: warm off-white background #FBF8F1; deep violet ink #28233F; saturated violet #7662E8; tangerine #FF8B59; mint #A7DCCD; a little yellow #F7CF63.
Constraints: no text of any kind, no characters, no outlines, no photorealism, no interface screenshot, no panel borders, no logos. The conceptual reading must remain clear and inviting.

alt.pt: Quatro etapas do pensamento computacional: decompor uma construção, identificar padrões, simplificar uma árvore e ordenar passos até uma meta.
alt.en: Four computational thinking concepts: decompose a building, recognize patterns, simplify a tree, and order steps toward a goal.

assets.review: Text-free composition checked; four left-to-right conceptual stations. Labels should be HTML and localized.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: wide text-free educational infographic for ScratchXR programming with blocks.
Primary request: one horizontal isometric flat illustration explaining visual programming. On the left, three generously sized colorful interlocking horizontal coding blocks are neatly stacked, one hat-shaped start block in warm yellow and two command blocks in violet and tangerine; only simple pictographic play, arrow, and turn symbols with NO lettering. In the center, a simple dotted sequence of solid small geometric tiles carries the programmed action from the block stack toward the right. On the right, a small original generic anime-inspired youthful VRoid-style human student avatar with short neutral brown hair, mint jacket, dark pants and simple shoes walks on a broad green isometric ground plane among one low-poly tree and a tiny pavilion; a smooth arc of three orange step markers illustrates its path. This is a visual metaphor for code driving a scene, not an actual interface screenshot.
Style/medium: modern isometric flat illustration, clean solid colored surfaces, NO outlines or strokes, consistent 30 degree perspective, polished educational editorial graphic for ages 10–16. The avatar is minimal and generic, not from any franchise.
Composition: wide 16:9 with blocks on left, connection in middle, scene on right, balanced negative space and generous margins. Build one cohesive composition.
Palette: warm off-white background #FBF8F1; deep violet ink #28233F; saturated violet #7662E8; tangerine #FF8B59; mint #A7DCCD; yellow #F7CF63.
Constraints: absolutely no written text, letters, digits or labels; no logos; no cats; no Chrono Trigger or any existing game characters; no outlined comic style; no photorealism; no device frame; no UI controls.

alt.pt: Blocos de programação conectados a um personagem caminhando por um cenário com árvore e construção.
alt.en: Programming blocks connected to a character walking through a scene with a tree and pavilion.

assets.review: No words or copyrighted characters; generic avatar is an illustration, not a production VRoid model.
